Pari - Research, Music & Opportunity Tracker v3 (Summer 2027)
source.note: Hand-maintained snapshot of the Drive sheets; re-sync by hand when they change. Carries NO contact email addresses on purpose (every data/*.json is PII-linted by scripts/validate_data.py, and a lint failure makes scan.sh run 'git checkout -- data/', which would revert uncommitted edits to THIS file too - so commit any hand edit promptly).

applications.title: BioBuilderClub (school team)
applications.note: Runs Oct-Mar

applications.title: CORE Summer Camps - 2027 interest form
applications.note: Grades 9-12, 15+; camp dates still TBA

applications.title: CMEA / SCSBOA All-State Honor Band
applications.action: Ask the band director to submit her audition
applications.note: Director usually submits; approx $25-50

applications.title: Stanford STaRS - eligibility question
applications.action: Email the program to ask whether she qualifies on her current visa
applications.note: Listed as 'US citizens or residents'; unresolved - worth one email

applications.title: CCCSEF science-fair pre-approval
applications.note: Needed before the Breath Power or hearing-health project collects data

applications.title: Lab cold emails - Batch 1
applications.note: Read one paper per lab first; resume finalised in Nov

applications.title: Teen Research week
applications.action: Register as soon as it opens
applications.note: Good fit for early June, before the Cleveland trip

applications.title: Lab cold emails - Batch 2 + Batch 1 follow-ups
applications.action: Send Batch 2; follow up on Batch 1
applications.note: Most labs want a start date after she turns 16

applications.title: Science fair / JSHS paper
applications.note: Same project feeds CCCSEF and the research applications

applications.title: Summer Youth Volunteer
applications.action: Check whether the program is open to non-local students
applications.note: Likely restricted to local students - verify before counting on it

applications.title: NFA High School Soloist Competition
applications.note: $65 + NFA student membership; finals Minneapolis Aug 2027. Cannot enter Junior and HS the same year

applications.title: Cleveland Clinic shadowing (3 areas, 20 hrs)
applications.note: 15+, so eligible either side of her birthday; immunisations required

applications.title: NFA Junior Soloist Competition
applications.action: Decide Junior vs HS Soloist - only one is allowed
applications.note: Age tier needs checking; may be the better fit at 15

applications.title: Lab cold emails - Batch 3
applications.note: Last batch before decisions in Mar-Apr

applications.title: Science Internship Program (SIP)
applications.note: Top pick. 7 weeks in person; approx $4,250 + $68 app fee; needs 1 teacher rec. Overlaps the Cleveland plan

applications.title: Lerner Research Institute lab volunteering
applications.note: 16+ only, so the placement must start after her 16th birthday. Biggest upside: a research letter

applications.title: SF Symphony Youth Orchestra
applications.note: Tuition-free but a reach; commute to SF

applications.title: Oakland Symphony Youth Orchestra
applications.note: East Bay; tuition if accepted

applications.title: AIMI virtual bootcamp
applications.action: Watch for the application to open
applications.note: Virtual - fits around either summer plan

applications.title: Summer volunteer - Benioff Oakland
applications.note: 16-18, so she qualifies only after her 16th birthday; 1 shift/week for 8 weeks

applications.title: Summer volunteer - Concord
applications.action: Attend the info session; ask if a late-June start is OK
applications.note: 16+ at start, so it depends on her 16th birthday

applications.title: Young People's Symphony Orchestra
applications.note: No application fee; weekly rehearsals + summer tour

applications.title: Hospital volunteering
applications.action: Apply any time once she is 16
applications.note: Year-round intake

applications.title: Community biotech lab
applications.action: Visit with a parent any time
applications.note: Open to under-16s when accompanied
